name: Market-mix sensitivity
source: Supplied IBSC casebook exhibits 1–2; Toyota electrified volume estimated in case
limit: Stable within-category shares are an assumption; neither Toyota forecast nor Auto2000 effect.

name: After-sales decomposition non-identifiability
formula: contribution index = cohort vehicles * jobs due * capture share * GP-per-job index
finding: Identical 25% decline can result from lower work due or lower capture; aggregate alone cannot distinguish them.
limit: Illustrates identification under the stated arithmetic only; values are normalized assumptions.

name: Existing service channel migration
formula: incremental job GP = change in completed Auto2000 jobs * realized GP-per-job
assumptions: 100 existing completed jobs remain 100; channel mix alone shifts; job mix, discounts and direct costs unchanged
limit: Potential cost savings and digital assistance are separate mechanisms, not assumed zero.

name: No dedicated home charger among EV intenders
type: approximate arithmetic from rounded nested survey shares
source: MS02; 61% home-preferring EV intenders; 54% of that subset dedicated-access
limit: Approximately 28.1% of all EV intenders under common-base interpretation lack dedicated access; shared access can be sufficient. Not inability to charge or lost demand.

name: Contribution break-even relationship
type: symbolic threshold, no observed input values
formula: required additional completed transactions = incremental program cost / net contribution per additional completed transaction
conditions: Positive net contribution; include partner share, cannibalization, discounts and displaced capacity; align period and cost basis
limit: No arbitrary cost, conversion, customer-base or margin value supplied; no ROI forecast.
